_comment: Tokenizer parity fixtures for EmbeddingGemma (google/embeddinggemma-300m vocabulary).
Each case's 'ids' must be the exact token ids produced by the Python AutoTokenizer
(WITH special tokens, i.e. tokenizer(text)['input_ids']). Empty 'ids' = placeholder:
the parity test skips itself with a reason until they are generated.

pip install transformers sentencepiece && python3 -c "import json; from transformers import AutoTokenizer; p='test/fixtures/embeddinggemma_tokenizer_fixtures.json'; d=json.load(open(p)); t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('onnx-community/embeddinggemma-300m-ONNX'); [c.update(ids=t(c['text'])['input_ids']) for c in d['cases']]; json.dump(d, open(p,'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)"
